verdict.rationale: monday.com lets users build custom agents from a plain-language workflow description, with goals and rules. Event subscriptions on `create_item` and `change_column_value` fire on incoming work, and agents can be assigned items and update statuses. Together these make AI triage of new items assemblable, and the deal-scoring example shows the same pattern of AI scoring items and acting on the result. However, no evidence shows an out-of-the-box bug or task triage and prioritization capability, so delivery depends on building and configuring an agent. Missing for 10: native AI triage/prioritization of incoming bugs and tasks, documentation of priority assignment or routing, hands-on or independent corroboration.
